question: Identify users who have earned a 'Teacher' badge, own at least one child post (i.e., a post with a non-null ParentId) that has a score of 50 or higher, and have had post history activity in the year 2013. For these users, return their display names along with the total number of comments on all their posts.

prediction.sql: SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS total_comments FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052" LEFT JOIN comments AS c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026" WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT b."XCL_002" FROM badges AS b WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher') AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT p2."XCL_033" FROM posts AS p2 WHERE NOT p2."XCL_043" IS NULL AND p2."XCL_031" >= 50) AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT ph."XCL_017" FROM postHistory AS ph WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ph."XCL_016") = '2013') GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"

semantic_memory.interpretation_policy: Assignments are conditional on the proposed role vocabulary; feasibility is not independent validation of business labels. Use original historical SQL and physical observations to compare competing interpretations.

eligibility.predicate: posts.XCL_043 IS NOT NULL AND posts.XCL_031 >= 50

measures.eligibility_application: Eligibility filters users only via EXISTS; comment count includes all comments on all posts owned by eligible users.
measures.multiplicity_argument: EXISTS ensures badge/postHistory/child-post rows do not multiply post or comment rows in the main query.

arguments.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS total_comments
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052" AND b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052" AND p2."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL AND p2."XCL_031" >= 50)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM postHistory ph WHERE ph."XCL_017" = u."XCL_052" AND strftime('%Y', ph."XCL_016") = '2013')
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"
